title: How do I run simulations and a power analysis to test for a 2 x 2 x 2 interaction?
body:
I conducted two 2 x 2 SPR studies in Spanish based on [Kush, Lidz, & Phillips (2015)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0749596X15000224?casa_token=etTE-PhjaL8AAAAA:sRaGSWa5n9bhm5p32J7Ibq9Ar3GbLTwB6prVwW1ttepofFBH8bpic-5Rqbm4t7MFjxYN3dTKLw). 

Both experiments manipulated the factors NP Referentiality (NP | QP) and GenderMatch between the NP/QP in an RC and a later pronoun in the MC (Match | Mismatch). We ran these studies in Spanish because it allows both preverbal and postverbal object pronouns. Accordingly, critical pronouns were preverbal in Exp. 1 and postverbal in Exp. 2. 

The question I want to answer is whether pronoun position (preverbal vs. postverbal) modulates interference from gender-matching but structurally-inappropriate QPs. To do so, I need to run a 2 x 2 x 2 experiment with the factors NP Referentiality, GenderMatch and Position and test for a 3-way interaction. 

**Goal:** Figure out how to run simulations and a power analysis to find out how many participants I'd need to find the 3-way interaction, if it were there.
